name: Check the dashboard text fitting
rationale:
utils.fitText() trims a label character by character until it fits. It stripped trailing
space with %s, which follows the C library's isspace(): where that matches 0x85 or 0xA0,
the pattern also ate the last byte of a UTF-8 character such as U+4F20 (E4 BC A0) and
handed the font a split character. The harness drives Latin, CJK and emoji labels
through every width and checks that each result is valid UTF-8 and fits. It was not a
CI job before, so it went red unnoticed when the dashboard started reading the screen
size from system.getVersion(); its fixture mocks that now.
